name: Fairmont Riyadh
positioning: Fairmont luxury hotel in Riyadh's Business Gate area, with Art Deco touches, a Fairmont Gold level and a spa with separate men's and women's facilities
best_for: Business travelers who want to be near the airport and Riyadh Exhibition Center
Guests who want a Fairmont Gold hotel-within-a-hotel stay

facts.text: Fairmont Riyadh is in the Business Gate area of Riyadh, about 15 minutes from King Khalid Airport.
The hotel is near the Riyadh Front Complex.
Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Riyadh skyline.
Standard rooms have Le Labo bath amenities and a rain shower.
Plaza Café is a lobby lounge serving international beverages and desserts.
Café Connect offers alfresco dining and light meals throughout the day.
The hotel has a fitness center.
Self-parking and valet parking are available.

highlights.text: House of Grill Riyadh serves dishes in an Art Deco setting.
Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel experience.
Fairmont Spa has separate facilities for men and women.
The Presidential Suite has Art Deco furnishings and butler service.

considerations.text: The indoor swimming pool is open during scheduled hours for men and women.
The hotel is in the Business Gate area, close to the airport and the Riyadh Exhibition Center, and hosts conferences and board meetings.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury business hotels.
